  "action": "shell",
  "command": "PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache

# Test R01: tags validation
try:
    TaggedCache(2).put('a', 1, 'bare_string')
    assert False
except ValueError:
    print('bare string rejected')

try:
    TaggedCache(2).put('a', 1, [1, 2])
    assert False
except ValueError:
    print('non-string entries rejected')

# Test deduplication
c = TaggedCache(5)
c.put('a', 1, ['x', 'x', 'y'])
assert 'a' in c._tags.get('x', set())
assert 'a' in c._tags.get('y', set())
assert len(c._tags.get('x', set())) == 1
print('Deduplication works')

# Test R02: replacing a key removes old tag memberships
c2 = TaggedCache(5)
c2.put('a', 1, ['old'])
assert 'a' in c2._tags.get('old', set())
c2.put('a', 2, ['new'])
assert 'a' not in c2._tags.get('old', set())
assert 'a' in c2._tags.get('new', set())
print('Old tags removed on replacement')

# Test R02: invalidate returns count
c3 = TaggedCache(5)
c3.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c3.put('b', 2, ['x'])
c3.put('c', 3, ['y'])
assert c3.invalidate('x') == 2
assert c3.invalidate('x') == 0
print('invalidate count correct')
